item.title: Machine learning for sample-based quantum diagonalization: a review of generative configuration recovery and the classical-simulability frontier
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nicolás Bonilla Vargas
arXiv:2608.05314v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), equivalently quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI), has become a centre of gravity of pre-fault-tolerant quantum chemistry: a processor samples electronic configurations and the Hamiltonian is diagonalized classically in the resulting subspace.
